chunks: Yet there are among those We have created people who lead (others) to the truth, and act justly in its light

key_terms.أُمَّةٌ: a community or group of people

ai.seo_question: Who are the people that guide to the truth and act justly according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as referring to the Ahl al-Bayt or the faithful who embody divine guidance, serving as the practical exemplars of justice (adl) derived from truth (haqq). It underscores the inseparable link between correct belief and righteous action, a core tenet of Shia theology where guidance is not merely theoretical but manifested in just conduct.
